title: Hold race meetings only at a licensed venue
what: Hold race meetings for betting only as a licensed club at its licensed venue.

sources.title: Racing Act 2002 (Qld)
sources.quote: A licensed club must not hold a contest, contingency or event in which 2 or more animals compete against each other for the purpose of providing a contest, contingency or event on which bets may be made unless— (a) the contest, contingency or event is held at a licensed venue of the licensed club;
